tools.description: Observe Axon's current surface: no app lists apps, app captures state, a semantic target pages children, and since returns a change check.

all.description: For no-target app lists, include all running processes. For direct semantic child requests, include all direct children.

app.description: Bundle id, pid, app name, or partial app name. Omit with target to list apps.

childDepth.description: Initial child depth for app observations. Use 0 to retain top-level windows only and page children by semantic target.

depth.description: Maximum tree depth to display for app observations, with windows at depth 0.

direct.description: For semantic targets, return only direct children without recursively capturing descendants.

format.description: Defaults to observation. Use debug only when diagnosing Axon internals.

frames.description: Include frames in observation output. Defaults to false.

limit.description: Maximum children for a semantic target. Defaults to Axon's sibling page size.

offset.description: Zero-based child offset for a semantic target. Defaults to 0.

screenText.description: OCR visible text from the app window screenshot and include it as organized screenText. Defaults to false.

screenshot.description: Include a downscaled window screenshot with a full app observation. Defaults to true; since change checks and semantic-target child pages are always imageless.

since.description: Snapshot id from a prior look response. Returns a coarse change check instead of a tree.

anyOf.description: Semantic element target object with required app and name fields. Run look first to observe canonical names.

app.description: Bundle id, pid, app name, or partial app name.

name.description: Semantic element name returned by look.

target.description: App-scoped semantic name returned by a prior look; pages that element's children.

tree.description: Include the nested AX tree for app observations. Defaults to true for observation format and false for debug format.

tools.title: look

tools.description: Navigate the active tab of a supported browser through its application scripting dictionary and verify the URL by read-back.

app.description: Safari or Google Chrome, by name or exact bundle identifier.

url.description: Absolute http or https URL, limited to 8192 bytes.

tools.name: navigate
tools.title: navigate

tools.description: Enumerate browser windows authoritatively through the supported app's scripting dictionary and cross-check them against AX when available.

app.description: Safari or Google Chrome, by name or exact bundle identifier.

tools.name: windows
tools.title: windows

tools.description: Enumerate browser tabs authoritatively through the supported app's scripting dictionary.

app.description: Safari or Google Chrome, by name or exact bundle identifier.

window.description: Optional one-based window index from windows().

tools.name: tabs
tools.title: tabs

tools.description: Resolve an AX locator against a fresh app snapshot.

app.description: Bundle id, pid, exact app name, or partial app name.

locator.description: AX locator with role, subrole, label, title, value, description, identifier, actions, and ancestors.

tools.name: find
tools.title: find

tools.description: Poll readable accessibility state from an app-scoped semantic name until a contains, equals, or regex predicate holds, or a bounded timeout reports the last observed state.

contains.description: Succeed when any readable field contains this text.

equals.description: Succeed when any readable field exactly equals this text.

intervalMs.description: Delay between polls. Defaults to 100 ms and is capped by the remaining timeout.

matches.description: Succeed when any readable field matches this regular expression.

anyOf.description: Semantic element target object with required app and name fields. Run look first to observe canonical names.

app.description: Bundle id, pid, app name, or partial app name.

name.description: Semantic element name returned by look.

target.description: App-scoped semantic name target returned by look.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time to poll before returning a failed timeout result. Defaults to 5000 ms and is capped at 60000 ms.

tools.name: wait_for_value
tools.title: wait_for_value

tools.description: Poll full app observations until the accessibility surface remains unchanged for a stability window or changes from its initial state; timeout returns the final observation.

app.description: Bundle id, pid, exact app name, or partial app name.

condition.description: stable waits for an unchanged stability window; changed waits for an observable app, tree, or focus change.

intervalMs.description: Delay between observations. At least 10 ms and capped by the remaining timeout.

stableMs.description: Required unchanged duration for the stable condition. Defaults to 300 ms and is capped at 10000 ms.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait. Defaults to 5000 ms and is capped at 60000 ms.

tools.title: wait_for_stability

tools.description: Ask macOS to show the Accessibility permission prompt for the running Axon daemon identity.
tools.name: permit
tools.title: permit

tools.description: Run a sequence of Axon actions from inline actions, a .axn path, or a path loaded first with inline actions appended.

actions.description: Ordered action objects, each with a tool field and that tool's normal arguments.

argValues.description: Caller-supplied .axn argument values keyed by declared arg name. Valid only for args without a declared source.

continueOnError.description: Continue after an action fails. Defaults to false.

dryRun.description: Trace the run without dispatching actions.

healedPath.description: Write a revised copy of the .axn to this path when replay resolves through drifted locator evidence. The source file is never modified.

path.description: Local .axn file path for the Axon daemon to read.

tools.name: run
tools.title: run

tools.description: Save recent recorded Axon calls as an editable .axn action file. Read calls are omitted unless includeReads is true.

includeReads.description: Include read/context tools such as look and find. Defaults to false.

path.description: Optional local path to write the .axn file.

sessionId.description: History session to export. Defaults to the daemon's default session.
